title: Phased Telemetry Gatekeeper for Safe Model Waves
creator: Aria Chen
description: Implement a policy engine that combines phased traffic schedules with telemetry-driven guardrails to automate safe canary/A-B rollouts and shadow probing. The engine (Gatekeeper) will evaluate SLO windows, population-level signals, and per-variant health to decide step progression, dynamic split adjustments, and automatic rollback. It must integrate with existing rollout APIs, the Console rollout page, and observability pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper can accept a declarative rollout plan with named steps and SLO targets
Engine evaluates real-time metrics (latency p95, error-rate, token-opt cost delta, quality-regression score) and exposes a decision outcome (advance, hold, revert)
Automatic rollback triggers when configured thresholds are breached for >2 consecutive evaluation windows
Shadow probe mode can route user percentage as shadow traffic and raise anomalies without impacting production split
Console shows step-by-step telemetry and reason for each decision; API endpoints return detailed decision trace IDs
Engine supports entropy-based step backoff to reduce step size when telemetry shows instability
implementation_notes: Introduce Gatekeeper controller as a sidecar-like decision service consumed by rollout controller
Evaluation window: default 60s sliding windows, configurable per rollout
Metrics: ingest latency p50/p95/p99, request error rate, model perplexity delta or eval score, cost per token delta
Decision policy DSL: conditions, composite predicates, decay/backoff parameters, and shadow probe directives
Store decision traces in tracing system with trace_id included in rollout events for auditability
Provide a simulation mode that replays past telemetry to validate rules before enabling auto-advance
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Implement primitive DSL and controller; unit tests + e2e smoke on dev cluster (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Integrate telemetry collectors and Console visualization; closed beta with SRE + 2 customers (3 weeks)
Phase 3: Add entropy-based step adjustment and shadow probe; harden rollback paths; performance testing (2 weeks)
Phase 4: Security review, docs, and GA rollout (2 weeks)
risks_mitigations: Risk: False positives in drift detector cause unnecessary rollback. Mitigation: require consecutive windows and composite metrics before reverting.
Risk: Added latency from decision service. Mitigation: cache last decision for short TTL and run async evaluation for non-critical steps.
Risk: Misconfiguration grants too-aggressive rollouts. Mitigation: default conservative step sizes and simulation mode on first enablement.
Risk: Telemetry gaps for new regions. Mitigation: region-aware hold policy and fallback to global-safe model variant
testing_strategy: Unit tests for DSL parsing and predicate evaluation
Integration tests that simulate metric streams and assert decision sequences
Chaos test: inject metric jitter to validate backoff/hold behavior
Canary of the Gatekeeper itself: deploy new Gatekeeper with shadow evaluation before live traffic switch
Customer-facing QA: run against two internal customers' test models with shadow traffic enabled
